source.nativeIdEvidence: OBJECTID_1 uniquely identifies native map records across the bounded protocol audit. One cadastral codigo repeats for two parts with non-overlapping interiors and a shared boundary. The current generic ArcGIS identity path rejects the differing parts; the code is not treated as a one-record-per-parcel key.
source.scope: Using the cadastral codigo as identity failed on one bounded viewport: two original map records (OBJECTID_1 44608 and 45458) have different polygon parts with non-overlapping interiors and a shared boundary under the same code. A separate native-record audit passed all bounded viewport, three-row paging, fresh exact-ID, absence, footprint and binding checks for 259 unique OBJECTID_1 records. All 259 geometries are valid, but a different pair (45091 and 44584) overlaps by 0.334 m² in independent metric GEOS QA. Runtime remains held for cadastral component identity and source-topology review, with no source repair or feature exclusion. Public access/reuse notices remain scope information.
